senses.en: shameful or dishonorable; lacking moral dignity

example.en: He left the job for an ignoble reason: pure greed.
example.zh: 他离开这份工作的原因很卑劣：纯粹出于贪婪。

senses.en: one of several levels or ranks in a graded system

example.en: The company offers support at three different tiers.
example.zh: 这家公司提供三个不同等级的支持。

senses.en: one of several rows or layers placed one above another

example.en: We had seats in the upper tier of the stadium.
example.zh: 我们坐在体育场上层的看台上。

senses.en: a place where things are stored

example.en: The library is a repository of rare manuscripts.
example.zh: 这座图书馆是珍贵手稿的收藏处。

senses.en: (computing) a place where code or data is stored and managed

example.en: The team pushed the new code to the shared repository.
example.zh: 团队把新代码推送到了共享代码库。

senses.en: a sign or piece of evidence that something is true or likely
senses.zh: 迹象；表明某事可能属实的信号

example.en: The survey found no indication of widespread dissatisfaction.
example.zh: 调查没有发现普遍不满的迹象。

senses.en: a medical condition that makes a particular treatment or test advisable

example.en: A family history of the disease can be an indication for genetic counseling.
example.zh: 该病的家族史可能是遗传咨询的指征。

senses.en: almost or nearly the thing mentioned; existing in effect though not in actual fact
senses.zh: 几乎的；实际上的；实质上的

example.en: The company has a virtual monopoly on the local market.
example.zh: 这家公司在当地市场几乎处于垄断地位。

senses.en: created by computer software rather than existing physically
senses.zh: 虚拟的；由计算机软件模拟的

example.en: Students attended a virtual class from home.
example.zh: 学生们在家参加了一堂虚拟课程。

senses.en: to become larger or greater in amount

example.en: Prices increase when demand rises.
example.zh: 需求上升时，价格会上涨。

senses.en: a rise in amount, level, or number

example.en: The company reported an increase in sales.
example.zh: 公司报告销售额有所增长。

senses.en: to make something larger or greater

example.en: We need to increase efficiency at work.
example.zh: 我们需要提高工作效率。

senses.en: a device with blades that moves air to cool or ventilate a space

example.en: She turned on the fan because the room was hot.
example.zh: 因为房间很热，她打开了风扇。

senses.en: a person who strongly admires a sport, team, performer, or activity

example.en: He is a fan of the local football team.
example.zh: 他是当地足球队的粉丝。

senses.en: to make a feeling stronger or more intense

example.en: The rumors fanned public anger.
example.zh: 谣言激起了公众的愤怒。

senses.en: in relation to or compared with something else

example.en: The house is relatively small compared with its neighbours.
example.zh: 与邻居的房子相比，这栋房子相对较小。

senses.en: to a fairly limited or moderate degree

example.en: The exam was relatively easy.
example.zh: 这次考试相当容易。

senses.en: an exact copy of something

example.en: Please keep a duplicate of the report for your records.
example.zh: 请留一份报告的副本存档。

senses.en: to make an exact copy of something; to do something again in the same way

example.en: The new app duplicates many features of the old one.
example.zh: 这款新应用重复了旧应用的许多功能。

senses.en: exactly the same as something else; additional and identical

example.en: She handed me a duplicate key to the office.
example.zh: 她给了我一把办公室的备用钥匙。

senses.en: to wander away from where one should be

example.en: The dog strayed from its yard and got lost.
example.zh: 那条狗走出了院子，迷路了。

senses.en: a lost animal, especially a pet without a home

example.en: The shelter takes care of stray cats and dogs.
example.zh: 收容所照顾流浪猫狗。

senses.en: lost, wandering, or occurring unexpectedly in small numbers

example.en: A stray bullet broke a window.
example.zh: 一颗流弹打碎了一扇窗户。

senses.en: lacking firmness or stiffness; not stiff or energetic

example.en: The lettuce looked limp after sitting in the fridge for a week.
example.zh: 生菜在冰箱里放了一周后看起来蔫了。

senses.en: to walk with difficulty because of an injured or painful leg

example.en: He limped off the field after twisting his ankle.
example.zh: 他扭伤脚踝后一瘸一拐地离开了球场。

senses.en: a way of walking that is uneven because of an injured leg

example.en: She still has a slight limp from the accident.
example.zh: 因为那次事故，她走路还有点跛。

senses.en: a person who manages the money and financial affairs of an organization or club

example.en: The club elected a new treasurer at last week's meeting.
example.zh: 俱乐部在上周的会议上选出了一位新司库。

senses.en: a minister in charge of a Christian church or congregation

example.en: Our pastor gave a moving sermon on forgiveness.
example.zh: 我们的牧师做了一场关于宽恕的感人布道。

senses.en: a close friend or companion

example.en: He has been my buddy since childhood.
example.zh: 他从小就是我的好伙伴。

senses.en: a friendly informal way to address someone (US)

example.en: Hey buddy, can you help me find this street?
example.zh: 嘿，老兄，能帮我找一下这条街吗？

senses.en: of the highest quality; excellent

example.en: The hotel offers first-rate service.
example.zh: 这家酒店提供一流的服务。

senses.en: in or at that place

example.en: I left my umbrella over there by the door.
example.zh: 我把伞落在那边门口了。

senses.en: used to introduce a sentence, showing that something exists or happens

example.en: There is a good restaurant near my office.
example.zh: 我办公室附近有一家不错的餐厅。

senses.en: used to draw attention to something or express satisfaction

example.en: There! The shelf is fixed at last.
example.zh: 好了！架子终于修好了。

senses.en: that place

example.en: We flew from Boston to there in three hours.
example.zh: 我们从波士顿飞到那里用了三个小时。

senses.en: the language spoken in China; 中文

example.en: She is learning Chinese at school.
example.zh: 她在学校学习中文。

senses.en: a person from China

example.en: Many Chinese live in this city.
example.zh: 许多中国人住在这座城市。

senses.en: relating to China, its people, or its culture
senses.zh: 中国的；中国人的；中文的

example.en: I love Chinese food.
example.zh: 我喜欢中国菜。

senses.en: the activities involved in promoting and selling a product or service

example.en: She works in the marketing department of a software company.
example.zh: 她在一家软件公司的市场营销部工作。

senses.en: to the same degree or amount

example.en: The two proposals are equally popular.
example.zh: 这两个提案同样受欢迎。

senses.en: in equal shares or in a fair, impartial way

example.en: The prize money was divided equally among the winners.
example.zh: 奖金在获胜者之间平分了。

senses.en: exactly; with complete accuracy

example.en: The train arrived at precisely three o'clock.
example.zh: 火车三点整准时到达。

senses.en: used to emphasize that something is exactly true or correct
senses.zh: 正是；确实如此（表示同意）

example.en: 'So you think we should wait?' 'Precisely.'
example.zh: “所以你认为我们应该等？”“正是。”

senses.en: exactly at or in a particular position or situation, often used with 'because' or 'when'

example.en: The plan failed precisely because of poor timing.
example.zh: 计划失败恰恰是因为时机不佳。

senses.en: a writing tool that uses ink

example.en: She signed the form with a blue pen.
example.zh: 她用一支蓝色的笔签署了表格。

senses.en: to write something

example.en: He penned a short letter to his old friend.
example.zh: 他给老朋友写了一封短信。

senses.en: a small fenced enclosure for animals

example.en: The lambs were kept in a pen behind the barn.
example.zh: 羊羔被圈在谷仓后面的围栏里。

senses.en: to shout or cry loudly

example.en: The child bawled when he dropped his ice cream.
example.zh: 孩子冰淇淋掉到地上时放声大哭。

senses.en: a narrow stretch of ground or runway for aircraft to take off and land

example.en: The plane landed on a dirt airstrip.
example.zh: 飞机降落在一条土质简易跑道上。

senses.en: abandoned and in poor condition

example.en: They explored a derelict warehouse near the docks.
example.zh: 他们探索了码头附近一座废弃的仓库。

senses.en: failing to do one's duty

example.en: The guard was accused of being derelict in his duty.
example.zh: 那名守卫被指控玩忽职守。

senses.en: a homeless person without a job or property

example.en: The city provides shelters for derelicts in winter.
example.zh: 市政府在冬天为流浪者提供收容所。

senses.en: to practice boxing with light, non-serious punches

example.en: The two boxers sparred in the gym.
example.zh: 两名拳击手在健身房里对练。

senses.en: a stout pole used to support sails or rigging on a ship

example.en: The sailor climbed the spar to fix the sail.
example.zh: 水手爬上桅杆去修帆。

senses.en: to argue or quarrel in a quick, verbal way

example.en: The two politicians sparred during the debate.
example.zh: 两位政治家在辩论中交锋。

senses.en: an insect with a long thin body and two pairs of transparent wings

example.en: A dragonfly hovered above the pond.
example.zh: 一只蜻蜓在池塘上空盘旋。

senses.en: a natural tendency to behave in a certain way, often something undesirable

example.en: He has a proclivity for exaggerating his achievements.
example.zh: 他有夸大自己成就的癖好。

senses.en: the art of beautiful handwriting

example.en: She studies Chinese calligraphy every weekend.
example.zh: 她每个周末都练习中国书法。

senses.en: in a very careful, exact, and honest way

example.en: She scrupulously checked every figure in the report.
example.zh: 她一丝不苟地核对了报告中的每一个数字。

senses.en: having only one color

example.en: The room was decorated in monochromatic shades of blue.
example.zh: 这个房间用单色系的蓝色装饰。

senses.en: (of light) having only one wavelength

example.en: Lasers emit highly monochromatic light.
example.zh: 激光器发出高度单频的光。

senses.en: continuing without any stops, especially a flight or bus

example.en: They took a nonstop flight from Beijing to New York.
example.zh: 他们乘坐了从北京到纽约的直飞航班。

senses.en: without stopping; continuously

example.en: It rained nonstop for three days.
example.zh: 雨连续下了三天不停。

senses.en: a flight that travels directly to its destination without intermediate stops

example.en: The nonstop to Tokyo leaves at noon.
example.zh: 直达东京的航班中午起飞。

senses.en: a type of rock made of compacted sand grains

example.en: The old temple was built from local sandstone.
example.zh: 这座古庙由当地砂岩建成。

senses.en: used to introduce the final point in a list

example.en: Lastly, I'd like to thank everyone who helped.
example.zh: 最后，我想感谢所有提供过帮助的人。

senses.en: a person who shoots with a bow and arrow

example.en: The archer hit the bullseye from fifty meters.
example.zh: 这名射箭运动员在五十米外射中了靶心。

senses.en: to keep doing something without stopping

example.en: She continued working after everyone else left.
example.zh: 其他人离开后，她继续工作。

senses.en: to start again after a pause or interruption

example.en: The meeting will continue after lunch.
example.zh: 会议将在午饭后继续。

senses.en: to remain in a state or position, or extend farther

example.en: The path continues along the river.
example.zh: 小路沿着河继续延伸。

senses.en: having a low temperature

example.en: The metal handle felt cold against my hand.
example.zh: 金属把手碰到我的手感觉很冷。

senses.en: a common viral illness that can cause a runny nose, sneezing, and coughing

example.en: She missed school because she had a cold.
example.zh: 她因为感冒没去上学。

senses.en: not friendly or showing warmth

example.en: His cold reply made her stop asking questions.
example.zh: 他冷淡的回答让她不再提问。

senses.en: low temperature or cold weather

example.en: The cold kept most people indoors.
example.zh: 寒冷的天气使大多数人待在室内。

senses.en: a person's opinion or way of thinking about something

example.en: Try to see the problem from my viewpoint.
example.zh: 试着从我的角度看这个问题。

senses.en: a place from which you can see something clearly

example.en: The hilltop offers a great viewpoint over the valley.
example.zh: 山顶是俯瞰山谷的绝佳观景点。

senses.en: a document or qualification that proves a person's ability, experience, or authority
senses.zh: 资格证书；凭证；证明文件

example.en: She showed her teaching credentials before the interview.
example.zh: 她在面试前出示了她的教师资格证书。

senses.en: information used to verify a user's identity when logging in
senses.zh: 登录凭据；身份验证信息

example.en: Enter your login credentials to access the account.
example.zh: 输入你的登录凭据以访问账户。

senses.en: a box in which a dead body is buried or cremated

example.en: The family chose a simple wooden coffin for the funeral.
example.zh: 家人为葬礼选了一口简单的木棺材。

senses.en: the act or fact of disappearing; no longer being seen or present

example.en: The disappearance of the plane remains a mystery.
example.zh: 那架飞机的失踪仍然是个谜。

senses.en: to make two things compatible or consistent with each other

example.en: It's hard to reconcile his promises with his actions.
example.zh: 他的承诺和他的行为很难一致。

senses.en: to restore a friendly relationship between people after a disagreement

example.en: The two friends were finally reconciled after their argument.
example.zh: 争吵之后，两位朋友终于和好了。

senses.en: to check that two sets of financial records agree (business use)

example.en: She reconciles the bank statement with the company's records every month.
example.zh: 她每月核对银行对账单和公司账目。

senses.en: to eat dinner

example.en: We usually dine at seven in the evening.
example.zh: 我们通常在晚上七点用餐。

senses.en: to treat someone to dinner or host a dinner

example.en: The company dined its new clients at an upscale restaurant.
example.zh: 公司在一家中高档餐厅宴请新客户。

senses.en: used to something because you have experienced it often

example.en: She is accustomed to working late.
example.zh: 她习惯了工作到很晚。

senses.en: usual or habitual

example.en: He left at his accustomed time.
example.zh: 他在惯常的时间离开了。

senses.en: to remove a ruler or government from power, especially by force

example.en: The rebels tried to overthrow the government.
example.zh: 叛军试图推翻政府。

senses.en: the act of removing a ruler or government from power

example.en: The overthrow of the dictator changed the country's history.
example.zh: 独裁者的被推翻改变了这个国家的历史。

senses.en: having the power to affect people or events

example.en: She is an influential writer whose books changed many lives.
example.zh: 她是一位有影响力的作家，她的书改变了许多人的生活。

senses.en: liquid sent out in tiny drops from a container or nozzle

example.en: She used a spray to water the plants.
example.zh: 她用一个喷壶给植物浇水。

senses.en: to scatter liquid in fine drops over something

example.en: The farmer sprayed the crops to protect them from insects.
example.zh: 农民给作物喷药以防虫害。

senses.en: masses of tiny water droplets in the air, as from waves

example.en: The waves threw spray over the rocks.
example.zh: 海浪把水花溅到岩石上。

senses.en: very unpleasant or disgusting

example.en: The weather turned nasty and we had to go inside.
example.zh: 天气变得很糟糕，我们只好进屋。

senses.en: unkind or mean; intending to hurt someone

example.en: Don't be so nasty to your little brother.
example.zh: 别对你弟弟那么刻薄。

senses.en: difficult or dangerous to deal with

example.en: The team faced a nasty problem during the project.
example.zh: 团队在项目期间遇到了一个棘手的问题。

senses.en: a follower of a teacher, leader, or religion

example.en: He gathered many disciples during his years of teaching.
example.zh: 他在讲学的岁月里收了许多门徒。

senses.en: a person who enjoys and knows a lot about fine food and drink

example.en: As a gourmet, he only eats at the finest restaurants.
example.zh: 作为美食家，他只在最高档的餐厅用餐。

senses.en: a small torn piece of paper or cloth

example.en: She tore the letter into shreds.
example.zh: 她把信撕成了碎片。

senses.en: a very small amount

example.en: There is not a shred of evidence to support his claim.
example.zh: 没有一丝证据能支持他的说法。

senses.en: to cut or tear something into small pieces

example.en: He shredded the documents before throwing them away.
example.zh: 他扔掉文件前把它们撕碎了。

senses.en: the quality of being refined, cultured, or worldly-wise

example.en: The hotel offers elegance and sophistication.
example.zh: 这家酒店兼具优雅与精致。

senses.en: the quality of being complex or highly developed

example.en: The software's sophistication impresses engineers.
example.zh: 这款软件的先进程度令工程师印象深刻。

senses.en: a short performance to test someone's suitability for a role

example.en: She has an audition for the lead role on Friday.
example.zh: 她周五有一个女主角角色的试演。

senses.en: to perform a piece to show one's suitability for a role

example.en: He auditioned for a place in the band.
example.zh: 他试演争取加入乐队。

senses.en: the sense of hearing

example.en: The hearing test measures auditory acuity, or audition.
example.zh: 听力测试测量听觉敏锐度，即听觉。

senses.en: making people unable to stop using or doing something
senses.zh: 使人上瘾的；令人成瘾的

example.en: Nicotine in cigarettes is highly addictive.
example.zh: 香烟中的尼古丁极易使人上瘾。

senses.en: an explanation that makes something easier to understand

example.en: She asked for clarification of the instructions.
example.zh: 她要求对这些说明作进一步澄清。

senses.en: to become weak or lose energy, often from sadness or neglect

example.en: The plants languished without enough sunlight.
example.zh: 缺少阳光，植物渐渐枯萎。

senses.en: to remain in an unpleasant or neglected situation for a long time; to fail to progress
senses.zh: 长期陷于（不快境地）；被搁置；毫无起色

example.en: The bill languished in the Senate for two years.
example.zh: 这项法案在参议院被搁置了两年。

senses.en: crossing or spanning a continent

example.en: They took a transcontinental train journey across Canada.
example.zh: 他们乘火车横穿了加拿大大陆。

senses.en: careful use of money; avoiding waste

example.en: Her frugality allowed her to retire early.
example.zh: 她的节俭使她得以提前退休。

senses.en: extremely stupid behavior or a very foolish remark

example.en: Cutting down all the trees was sheer idiocy.
example.zh: 砍光所有的树简直是愚蠢至极。

senses.en: to echo with sound; to repeat sound in waves

example.en: The sound of the bell reverberated through the valley.
example.zh: 钟声在山谷中回荡。

senses.en: to have a strong or lasting effect
senses.zh: 产生长远影响；持续反响

example.en: The scandal reverberated through politics for years.
example.zh: 那起丑闻在政坛影响多年。

senses.en: to give out or assign as a share or amount

example.en: The teacher allotted ten minutes for the quiz.
example.zh: 老师分配了十分钟来做小测验。

senses.en: a small light carriage pulled by one horse

example.en: They rode a buggy across the farm.
example.zh: 他们坐着马车穿过农场。

senses.en: full of bugs, or (of software) having many faults
senses.zh: 多虫的；（软件）有很多漏洞的

example.en: The first release of the app was buggy.
example.zh: 这个应用的第一个版本有很多漏洞。

senses.en: (US) a small cart for shopping or golf

example.en: She pushed a shopping buggy through the store.
example.zh: 她推着购物车穿过商店。

senses.en: a sign of something, especially something good or bad, that will happen in the future

example.en: Dark clouds gathered, which they took as an omen of the coming storm.
example.zh: 乌云密布，他们把这看作暴风雨将至的征兆。

senses.en: a treatment in which thin needles are inserted at particular points of the body

example.en: Some people use acupuncture to relieve back pain.
example.zh: 有些人用针灸来缓解背痛。

senses.en: (rare) to treat someone using acupuncture

example.en: The practitioner acupunctured the patient's shoulder.
example.zh: 针灸师在患者的肩部施针。

senses.en: people who read, especially people who read a particular book or publication

example.en: The magazine has thousands of loyal readers.
example.zh: 这本杂志拥有成千上万的忠实读者。

senses.en: electronic devices or simple books used for reading

example.en: E-book readers are popular among commuters.
example.zh: 电子阅读器在通勤族中很受欢迎。

senses.en: the way people, groups, or countries deal with and connect to each other

example.en: The two countries are working to improve their relations.
example.zh: 两国正在努力改善彼此的关系。

senses.en: family members

example.en: All his close relations attended the wedding.
example.zh: 他所有的近亲都参加了婚礼。

senses.en: the range of colors or wavelengths produced when light or other waves are separated

example.en: The scientists studied the spectra of distant stars.
example.zh: 科学家研究了遥远恒星的光谱。

senses.en: a broad range of related ideas or qualities

example.en: The debate covers a wide spectrum of opinions, and their spectra of views differ greatly.
example.zh: 这场辩论涵盖了广泛的意见，他们的观点范围差异很大。

senses.en: a person or thing being discussed, studied, or dealt with

example.en: Climate change is a popular subject of discussion.
example.zh: 气候变化是人们热议的话题。

senses.en: a branch of knowledge studied at school

example.en: Math is my favorite subject at school.
example.zh: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

senses.en: a person studied or experimented on in research

example.en: All the subjects in the study were volunteers.
example.zh: 这项研究中的所有受试者都是自愿参加的。

senses.en: (grammar) the part of a sentence that performs the action

example.en: In 'The dog barks', 'the dog' is the subject.
example.zh: 在“The dog barks”中，“the dog”是主语。
